# scylladbcloud_regions (Data Source)

The regions of a cloud provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scylladbcloud_regions" "example" {
	cloud = "GCP"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider, AWS or GCP.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `regions` (List of Object) Regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `continent` (String)
- `datacenter` (String)
- `full_name` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `region_id` (Number)
